function.name: memory
function.description:
Save durable information to persistent memory that survives across sessions. Memory is injected into future turns, so keep it compact and focused on facts that will still matter later.

WHEN TO SAVE (do this proactively, don't wait to be asked):
- User corrects you or says 'remember this' / 'don't do that again'
- User shares a preference, habit, or personal detail (name, role, timezone, coding style)
- You discover something about the environment (OS, installed tools, project structure)
- You learn a convention, API quirk, or workflow specific to this user's setup
- You identify a stable fact that will be useful again in future sessions

PRIORITY: User preferences and corrections > environment facts > procedural knowledge. The most valuable memory prevents the user from having to repeat themselves.

Do NOT save task progress, session outcomes, completed-work logs, or temporary TODO state to memory; use session_search to recall those from past transcripts.
If you've discovered a new way to do something, solved a problem that could be necessary later, save it as a skill with the skill tool.

TWO TARGETS:
- 'user': who the user is -- name, role, preferences, communication style, pet peeves
- 'memory': your notes -- environment facts, project conventions, tool quirks, lessons learned

ACTIONS: add (new entry), replace (update existing -- old_text identifies it), remove (delete -- old_text identifies it).

SKIP: trivial/obvious info, things easily re-discovered, raw data dumps, and temporary task state.

target.description: Which memory store: 'memory' for personal notes, 'user' for user profile.

content.description: The entry content. Required for 'add' and 'replace'.

old_text.description: Short unique substring identifying the entry to replace or remove.

function.name: skill_manage
function.description:
Manage skills (create, update, delete). Skills are your procedural memory — reusable approaches for recurring task types. New skills go to ~/.hermes/skills/; existing skills can be modified wherever they live.

Actions: create (full SKILL.md + optional category), patch (old_string/new_string — preferred for fixes), edit (full SKILL.md rewrite — major overhauls only), delete, write_file, remove_file.

On delete, pass `absorbed_into=<umbrella>` when you're merging this skill's content into another one, or `absorbed_into=""` when you're pruning it with no forwarding target. This lets the curator tell consolidation from pruning without guessing, so downstream consumers (cron jobs that reference the old skill name, etc.) get updated correctly. The target you name in `absorbed_into` must already exist — create/patch the umbrella first, then delete.

Create when: complex task succeeded (5+ calls), errors overcome, user-corrected approach worked, non-trivial workflow discovered, or user asks you to remember a procedure.
Update when: instructions stale/wrong, OS-specific failures, missing steps or pitfalls found during use. If you used a skill and hit issues not covered by it, patch it immediately.

After difficult/iterative tasks, offer to save as a skill. Skip for simple one-offs. Confirm with user before creating/deleting.

Good skills: trigger conditions, numbered steps with exact commands, pitfalls section, verification steps. Use skill_view() to see format examples.

Pinned skills are protected from deletion only — skill_manage(action='delete') will refuse with a message pointing the user to `hermes curator unpin <name>`. Patches and edits go through on pinned skills so you can still improve them as pitfalls come up; pin only guards against irrecoverable loss.

name.description: Skill name (lowercase, hyphens/underscores, max 64 chars). Must match an existing skill for patch/edit/delete/write_file/remove_file.

content.description: Full SKILL.md content (YAML frontmatter + markdown body). Required for 'create' and 'edit'. For 'edit', read the skill first with skill_view() and provide the complete updated text.

old_string.description: Text to find in the file (required for 'patch'). Must be unique unless replace_all=true. Include enough surrounding context to ensure uniqueness.

new_string.description: Replacement text (required for 'patch'). Can be empty string to delete the matched text.

replace_all.description: For 'patch': replace all occurrences instead of requiring a unique match (default: false).

category.description: Optional category/domain for organizing the skill (e.g., 'devops', 'data-science', 'mlops'). Creates a subdirectory grouping. Only used with 'create'.

file_path.description: Path to a supporting file within the skill directory. For 'write_file'/'remove_file': required, must be under references/, templates/, scripts/, or assets/. For 'patch': optional, defaults to SKILL.md if omitted.

file_content.description: Content for the file. Required for 'write_file'.

absorbed_into.description: For 'delete' only — declares intent so the curator can tell consolidation from pruning without guessing. Pass the umbrella skill name when this skill's content was merged into another (the target must already exist). Pass an empty string when the skill is truly stale and being pruned with no forwarding target. Omitting the arg on delete is supported for backward compatibility but downstream tooling (e.g. cron-job skill reference rewriting) will have to guess at intent.

{"content": "     1|#!/bin/bash
     2|# hermes-rotate-coordinator: CLI untuk rotasi koordinator domain
     3|# Penggunaan: hermes-rotate-coordinator --domain X --new-coord Y --project Z
     4|# Penggunaan status: hermes-rotate-coordinator --status [domain]
     5|# Hanya bisa dijalankan oleh root (Anda sebagai pemilik VPS)
     6|
     7|set -e
     8|
     9|DOMAIN=""
    10|NEW_COORD=""
    11|PROJECT=""
    12|ROTATION_FILE="/usr/local/lib/hermes-orchestrator/rotation_state.json"
    13|
    14|# Cek apakah ini permintaan status
    15|if [[ "$1" == "--status" ]]; then
    16|  shift
    17|  DOMAIN_STATUS="${1:-all}"
    18|  echo "╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗"
    19|  echo "║  📊 Status Rotasi Koordinator Domain                   ║"
    20|  echo "╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝"
    21|  if [ "$DOMAIN_STATUS" == "all" ]; then
    22|    jq -r '.domains | to_entries[] | [ "Domain: " + .key, "  Koordinator: " + .value.current_coordinator, "  Port: " + (.value.coordinator_port|tostring), "  Last Rotation: " + .value.last_rotation, "  Policy: " + .value.rotation_policy ] | join("\n")' "$ROTATION_FILE"
    23|  else
    24|    jq -r ".domains.${DOMAIN_STATUS} | [ \"Domain: ${DOMAIN_STATUS}\", \"  Koordinator: \" + .current_coordinator, \"  Port: \" + (.coordinator_port|tostring), \"  Last Rotation: \" + .last_rotation, \"  Policy: \" + .rotation_policy ] | join("\n")" "$ROTATION_FILE"
    25|  fi
    26|  exit 0
    27|fi
    28|
    29|# Parse arguments untuk rotasi
    30|while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    31|  case $1 in
    32|    --domain)
    33|      DOMAIN="$2"
    34|      shift 2
    35|      ;;
    36|    --new-coord)
    37|      NEW_COORD="$2"
    38|      shift 2
    39|      ;;
    40|    --project)
    41|      PROJECT="$2"
    42|      shift 2
    43|      ;;
    44|    *)
    45|      echo "Usage: hermes-rotate-coordinator [--status [domain]]"
    46|      echo "       hermes-rotate-coordinator --domain <domain> --new-coord <agent_name> --project <project_name>"
    47|      exit 1
    48|      ;;
    49|  esac
    50|done
    51|
    52|# Validasi
    53|if [ -z "$DOMAIN" ] || [ -z "$NEW_COORD" ] || [ -z "$PROJECT" ]; then
    54|  echo "❌ Error: --domain, --new-coord, dan --project wajib diisi."
    55|  exit 1
    56|fi
    57|
    58|if [ ! -f "$ROTATION_FILE" ]; then
    59|  echo "❌ Error: File state rotasi tidak ditemukan di $ROTATION_FILE"
    60|  exit 1
    61|fi
    62|
    63|echo "╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗"
    64|echo "║  🔄 Rotasi Koordinator Domain: ${DOMAIN}               ║"
    65|echo "╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝"
    66|
    67|# Cek domain ada
    68|CURRENT_COORD=$(jq -r ".domains.${DOMAIN}.current_coordinator // empty" "$ROTATION_FILE")
    69|if [ -z "$CURRENT_COORD" ]; then
    70|  echo "❌ Domain '$DOMAIN' tidak ditemukan di state rotasi."
    71|  exit 1
    72|fi
    73|
    74|echo "📌 Koordinator saat ini: $CURRENT_COORD"
    75|echo "🎯 Koordinator baru   : $NEW_COORD"
    76|echo "📂 Proyek             : $PROJECT"
    77|
    78|# Update state rotasi menggunakan Python (lebih aman untuk JSON)
    79|python3 << EOF
    80|import json
    81|from datetime import datetime, timezone
    82|
    83|rotation_file = "$ROTATION_FILE"
    84|domain = "$DOMAIN"
    85|new_coord = "$NEW_COORD"
    86|project = "$PROJECT"
    87|
    88|with open(rotation_file, 'r') as f:
    89|    state = json.load(f)
    90|
    91|# Update domain
    92|domain_data = state['domains'][domain]
    93|old_coord = domain_data['current_coordinator']
    94|
    95|# Tambahkan ke history yang lama
    96|if 'rotation_history' not in domain_data:
    97|    domain_data['rotation_history'] = []
    98|
    99|# Tutup entri lama
   100|for entry in domain_data['rotation_history']:
   101|    if entry['end_date'] is None:
   102|        entry['end_date'] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace('+00:00', 'Z')
   103|
   104|# Entri baru
   105|new_entry = {
   106|    "coordinator": new_coord,
   107|    "start_date": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace('+00:00', 'Z'),
   108|    "end_date": None,
   109|    "project": project,
   110|    "triggered_by": "user"
   111|}
   112|domain_data['rotation_history'].append(new_entry)
   113|domain_data['current_coordinator'] = new_coord
   114|domain_data['last_rotation'] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace('+00:00', 'Z')
   115|
   116|# Tambahkan ke log rotasi global
   117|state['rotation_log'].append({
   118|    "timestamp": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace('+00:00', 'Z'),
   119|    "domain": domain,
   120|    "old_coordinator": old_coord,
   121|    "new_coordinator": new_coord,
   122|    "project": project,
   123|    "triggered_by": "user"
   124|})
   125|
   126|with open(rotation_file, 'w') as f:
   127|    json.dump(state, f, indent=2)
   128|
   129|print("✅ State rotasi berhasil diperbarui.")
   130|EOF
   131|
   132|echo ""
   133|echo "📋 Riwayat rotasi domain '$DOMAIN':"
   134|jq -r ".domains.${DOMAIN}.rotation_history[] | \"  - \(.coordinator) (\(.project)): \(.start_date)\"" "$ROTATION_FILE"
   135|
   136|echo ""
   137|echo "⚠️ CATATAN: Anda perlu mengupdate konfigurasi agen secara manual jika diperlukan."
   138|echo "   Atau gunakan 'hermes-new-agent' untuk agen koordinator baru."

{"path": "/usr/local/lib/hermes-orchestrator/auto-rotate-coordinator.py", "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Auto-Rotate Coordinator: Rotasi otomatis berdasarkan policy domain
- per_project: Rotasi ketika proyek selesai (cek task queue)
- fixed: Tidak rotasi otomatis
- periodic: Rotasi berdasarkan interval waktu
"""

import json
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

ROTATION_STATE = Path("/usr/local/lib/hermes-orchestrator/rotation_state.json")
API_BASE = "http://localhost:8000"

def log(msg):
    print(f"[{datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] {msg}")

def load_state():
    if not ROTATION_STATE.exists():
        log(f"❌ State file not found: {ROTATION_STATE}")
        sys.exit(1)
    with open(ROTATION_STATE) as f:
        return json.load(f)

def save_state(state):
    with open(ROTATION_STATE, 'w') as f:
        json.dump(state, f, indent=2)

def check_project_completion(domain, project_name):
    """Cek apakah proyek sudah selesai (semua task completed)"""
    import urllib.request
    try:
        url = f"{API_BASE}/tasks?tags={domain}"
        with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=5) as resp:
            tasks = json.loads(resp.read())
            project_tasks = [t for t in tasks if t.get('project') == project_name]
            if not project_tasks:
                return False
            all_done = all(t.get('status') in ['completed', 'cancelled'] for t in project_tasks)
            return all_done
    except Exception as e:
        log(f"⚠️  Cannot check project completion: {e}")
        return False

def get_next_coordinator(domain, current):
    """Dapatkan koordinator berikutnya (round-robin sederhana)"""
    # Mapping domain ke daftar koordinator yang tersedia
    coord_pool = {
        "pendidikan": ["hermes-pendidikan", "hermes-sandbox", "hermes-flowforce"],
        "infrastructure": ["hermes-infrastructure", "hermes-infra"],
        "builder": ["hermes-builder", "hermes-architect"],
        "plaza": ["hermes-plaza", "hermes-market"]
    }
    pool = coord_pool.get(domain, [current])
    if current in pool:
        idx = pool.index(current)
        return pool[(idx + 1) % len(pool)]
    return pool[0] if pool else current

def rotate(domain, new_coord, project, triggered_by="auto"):
    """Eksekusi rotasi via CLI"""
    import subprocess
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["hermes-rotate-coordinator", "--domain", domain, "--new-coord", new_coord, "--project", project],
        capture_output=True, text=True
    )
    if result.returncode == 0:
        log(f"✅ Rotated {domain}: {new_coord} (project: {project})")
        return True
    else:
        log(f"❌ Rotation failed: {result.stderr}")
        return False

def process_domain(domain, data, state):
    """Proses rotasi untuk satu domain"""
    policy = data.get("rotation_policy", "fixed")
    current = data.get("current_coordinator")
    
    if policy == "fixed":
        log(f"⏸️  {domain}: Policy=fixed, skip")
        return
    
    if policy == "per_project":
        # Cek proyek aktif terakhir
        history = data.get("rotation_history", [])
        active_entry = next((e for e in reversed(history) if e.get("end_date") is None), None)
        if not active_entry:
            log(f"⏸️  {domain}: No active project")
            return
        
        project = active_entry.get("project")
        if not project or project == "initial_setup":
            log(f"⏸️  {domain}: Initial setup, skip")
            return
        
        if check_project_completion(domain, project):
            log(f"🎯 {domain}: Project '{project}' completed, rotating...")
            new_coord = get_next_coordinator(domain, current)
            rotate(domain, new_coord, f"auto-rotation-{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d')}", triggered_by="auto")
        else:
            log(f"⏳ {domain}: Project '{project}' still in progress")
    
    elif policy == "periodic":
        # Rotasi berdasarkan interval (misal: 7 hari)
        last_rotation = data.get("last_rotation")
        if last_rotation:
            last_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(last_rotation.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
            if datetime.now(timezone.utc) - last_dt < timedelta(days=7):
                log(f"⏸️  {domain}: Periodic rotation not due yet")
                return
        log(f"🎯 {domain}: Periodic rotation due, rotating...")
        new_coord = get_next_coordinator(domain, current)
        rotate(domain, new_coord, f"periodic-rotation-{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d')}", triggered_by="auto")

def main():
    log("🔄 Auto-Rotate Coordinator started")
    state = load_state()
    
    for domain, data in state.get("domains", {}).items():
        try:
            process_domain(domain, data, state)
        except Exception as e:
            log(f"❌ Error processing {domain}: {e}")
    
    log("✅ Auto-Rotate Coordinator finished")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
"}
